Puede usar atributos de "peso" (Weight) para aplicar transformaciones parciales a los puntos.

useCases: Toroidal field generators for sci-fi effects

examples.name: Fusion Ring
examples.description: Torus POP (Major=2, Minor=0.1) → Particle POP (Lorentz attractor via GLSL)

examples.name: Ring Emitter
examples.description: Torus POP → Noise POP (deform) → Particle POP

examples.name: Animated Torus
examples.description: Torus POP → Transform POP (rotate axes with LFO)

commonCombinations: Torus POP → Noise POP (deform ring surface)
Torus POP → GLSL POP (custom surface shaders)
Torus POP → Copy POP (scatter objects on torus)

troubleshooting.solution: Increase Minor Radius relative to Major Radius.

description: GPU-accelerated torus (donut) geometry generator. Creates ring-shaped surfaces with configurable major/minor radii and tubular/radial divisions. Ideal for fusion rings, orbital emitters, and toroidal fields.
